text.slice: The port is based on two firmware packages: the "base" (OriginOS — the source of the shell itself) and the "stock" firmware of the phone to which the port is being transferred.
Unpack the payload.bin of the OriginOS base and extract the following partitions:
system, system_ext, product, dyn.img, oem.img, vgc.img

Step 4. Transferring .prop Files from vgc / oem / dyn
Copy and paste the contents of the following files into system/system/build.prop:
In the same build.prop, find the line:
The value of this prop will show which Android version (A10–A16) you need to take phh_init for.
The phh_init files are located here:
Inside are subfolders for each Android version: A10, A11, A12, A13, A14, A15, A16.
Select the subfolder corresponding to the value of ro.system.build.version.release from Step 5, and transfer its contents to system/system/ of the port with file replacement.
Copy all vndk apex files from stock/system_ext/apex/ to port/system_ext/apex/.
If such an apex is not yet present in OriginOS (e.g., vndk34 is missing) — copy it.
If such an apex already exists — leave it untouched by default.
Exception: if a bootloop occurs after building and flashing — try replacing the already existing apex with the version from stock, even if it was already there.
It is recommended to build in erofs, raw format.
A vendor partition from any Android version is suitable for the port — to any Android version of the base.
